tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background for every article and page. The warm ground the whole brand sits on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on paper: sidebars, footers, glossary panels, cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on paper, paper-raised, sage and marigold-soft (10.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, bylines, dates and reference lists on paper and paper-raised (5.1:1 or better). Not for body copy.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The brand teal. Links, the masthead, primary buttons and key headings on paper and paper-raised (5.3:1 or better). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill, such as a primary button (6.3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta, used sparingly for warmth: section kickers, pull-quote marks and illustration fills. As text, only on paper (4.6:1). White on an accent fill passes (5.0:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Background for 'In short' summary boxes and definitions. Put ink or brand text on it.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Highlight fill: key-fact markers and illustration. Set ink on it (7.0:1). Never use it as text.

tokens.name: marigold-soft
tokens.usage: Background for 'Good to know' callouts. Set ink text on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Only for 'Seek urgent help' warnings: the title and border on paper (6.7:1). Always pair it with the words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules and card borders on paper. It is not strong enough to carry meaning on its own.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: What your blood test actually says
styles.usage: Article titles on the homepage and hero. One per page.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: The article title on an article page.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsections, card titles and callout titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Blood pressure is the force of blood pushing against the walls of your arteries.
styles.usage: Long-form article copy. Keep lines at 60 to 72 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, bylines, footnotes and reference lists, in ink-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Topic labels above titles, in uppercase, in accent or brand.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The gap between a kicker and its title, and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing and inner padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The gap between article sections and above each h2.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons (as pills, at half their height) and large feature panels.
